name: Developerlook
details: Developer-focused platform UI showcasing articles, resources, and tools for engineering teams.
features: Grid-based layout for content cards and featured posts.
Dark theme design with accent colors for interactions.
Responsive design with attention to spacing and legibility.
Call-to-action sections encouraging signups or newsletter joins.

name: Syntech
details: Modern SaaS landing platform for a technology company, focused on clear value proposition, pricing, and lead capture for B2B customers.
features: Hero section with prominent primary CTA and supporting secondary actions.
Responsive layout optimized for desktop and mobile breakpoints.
Sections for product overview, feature grid, customer logos, and testimonial highlights.
Sticky navigation with smooth scrolling to key sections.
Conversion-focused footer with multiple contact and demo request entry points.

name: Elevate
details: Clean, professional marketing site for a digital product or service helping teams elevate their workflows.
features: Hero layout with bold headline and supporting visuals.
Feature sections organized in responsive card grids.
Testimonials and logos to build trust and credibility.
Footer with navigation, contact, and social links.

name: Staffic.io
details: Time-tracking and workforce management platform with dashboards for teams, managers, and operations stakeholders.
features: Dashboard views for tracking team time entries and utilization in real time.
Projects and tasks overview with quick filtering and search.
Modular cards for key metrics such as billable hours, active timers, and timesheet status.
Responsive layout with clear information hierarchy and accessible color contrast.

name: Regulatory Jobs
details: Niche job board platform for regulatory careers with advanced filtering and rich job details.
features: Job listings grid with filters for role, location, and seniority.
Job details pages with sticky apply section and related jobs.
Saved jobs and recently viewed interactions.
Content sections explaining employer benefits and candidate features.

name: Literalhub
details: Specialized job marketplace for legal professionals connecting candidates with top-tier law firms.
features: Landing page focused on law firms and lateral candidates.
Highlighted partner firms and key platform statistics.
Conversion-focused CTAs for signing up and posting jobs.
Responsive layout with polished typography and imagery.

name: Fusion Kitchen
details: Frontend-focused restaurant and food ordering experience highlighting menu items, offers, and reservation flows.
features: Hero section with promotional offer and clear call-to-action.
Category-based menu sections with images and pricing.
Call-to-action buttons for table booking and online orders.
Responsive layout optimized for both mobile and desktop diners.

name: Language Guard
details: This is a Foreign language learning website based on MERN Stack development. On this website, I have implemented 3 role-based user interfaces and functionalities. The roles are student, instructor, and admin. Please visit the project repository to know further about this project.
features: Dark-light toggle theme.
Authentication system with firebase.
Students can easily enroll in classes, book and manage their reservations, give feedback, delete bookings, and conveniently pay for their courses.
Instructors have the ability to add new classes, to monitor his added classes.
Administrators can efficiently manage classes, users, and assign instructor and admin roles, approved / denied classes.
Admins can give feedback to instructors about their classes.
Student can send message in the contact us section
